newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Telrad buys shares in parent Koor.
newsitem.headline: Telrad buys shares in parent Koor.

text.p: Telrad Holdings Ltd said on Sunday it had purchased about $4 million of shares in its parent company, Koor Industries Ltd, Israel's largest industrial concern.
Telrad said it purchased off-the-floor 42,365 shares at 305.735 shekels each on April 16.
Telrad now owns 71,344 shares in Koor, equal to 0.245 percent of the equity or 0.472 percent of the voting rights.
Koor said last week that its wholly owned subsidiary Telrad had decided to purchase $5 million worth of Koor shares.
Israeli companies are prohibited by law from buying their own shares but subsidiaries may buy shares in parent companies.
